name: invoiceflow-landing
description: Modern, accessible landing page for InvoiceFlow - an invoice management solution with comprehensive documentation and deployment-ready configuration
author: InvoiceFlow Team

scripts.build:html: shx mkdir -p dist && shx cp -r *.html dist/
scripts.build:assets: shx mkdir -p dist/css dist/js && shx cp -r css/*.css dist/css/ && shx cp -r js/*.js dist/js/
scripts.build: shx rm -rf dist && npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:html && npm run build:assets
scripts.test: npm run test:html && npm run test:css && npm run test:js
scripts.lint: npm run test:html && npm run test:css && npm run test:js
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npx serve dist -l 8080
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run build
